//: Copy to <repo>/.egress-policy.json and edit. See docs/opencode-plugin-evaluation.md.

destinations.//allow: Deny-by-default. Name exact provider/model ids. A broker-wide wildcard such as openrouter/* is not a destination: OpenRouter routes to whichever upstream it chooses, so the recipient becomes a routing outcome rather than a decision.

rules.//: Override any detector: block | redact | warn | off.

paths.//deny: Naming one of these in a payload is itself the finding. This list REPLACES the built-in defaults rather than adding to them, so it is the built-in list in full: drop a glob from it only deliberately, and keep the rest.
paths.//workspace_roots: Empty means any workspace. Set it to pin delegation to known trees.

audit.//path: Empty uses the per-OS state directory.
